mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_sets (owner_token, user_id, title, question_count, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerToken}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{questionCount}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_token, user_id, title, question_count, created_at FROM quiz_sets WHERE owner_token = #{ownerToken} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, owner_token, user_id, title, question_count, created_at FROM quiz_sets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
